errors.text_span: All lines start near a training loss of 0.85 at step 0k
errors.evidence: The curves begin around 0.75–0.82 on the y-axis, not 0.85; 0.85 is the top axis limit, not the starting value.
At 20k steps, the lines are generally around roughly 0.15–0.25 depending on the series; 0.2 is an imprecise summary rather than a clearly supported exact point.
At the end of the plotted range, the losses are mostly around 0.03–0.06, so the upper bound of 0.15 is too high for the visible final values.
